name: Pasta
intro: Cherry tomatoes burst in olive oil until they become the sauce. Halibut flaked in, or nothing at all.

variations.context: Seared halibut flaked in at the end, basil.
The default. Burst tomatoes and basil, nothing else.
Jalapeño and lime instead of basil.

finish: Heat olive oil and a sliced garlic clove in a wide pan, add the whole cherry tomatoes, and cook until they split and slump, pressing a few to release their juice. Toss with the pasta and a splash of pasta water. Basil goes in after the heat is off.
